text:
marta (finance): morning — we saw 12 NetSuite sync rejections overnight. Error: "Line amount must be >= 0". All tied to the recent pricing experiment with overflow promo.

josh (eng-billing): do we have a sample invoice id?

marta (finance): invoice_2026_11_06_21. Payload snippet below (sanitized). NetSuite retried then created a memo that doesn't match Stripe.

anika (revops): AR flagged a variance. can we pause customer notices until we confirm scope?

billing-bot: webhook_retry: invoice.created invoice_2026_11_06_21 attempts=3 status=400 ns_err="Line amount must be >= 0"

marta (finance): payload:
{"id":"invoice_2026_11_06_21","lines":[{"desc":"usage","amount":75.0},{"desc":"tier_disc","amount":-8.25},{"desc":"promo_overflow","amount":-66.74999999999999}],"total":-0.0}

josh (eng-billing): that -66.74999999999999 is a JS float artifact. After 2-decimal rounding some lines become -0.01 and NetSuite rejects.

anika (revops): impacted customers? mid-market list?

marta (finance): sending IDs to CS queue now. Two already had manual credit memos; finance ops will clean those.

josh (eng-billing): mitigation: will add producer-side fixed-2 formatting and a sync-side normalization to clamp tiny negatives to 0.00 and tag invoices with "normalized". Adding unit tests.

billing-bot: deploy started: fix/rounding-clamp -> staging (sha: c3d2b1)

marta (finance): please let CS know 2hr before prod flip.

josh (eng-billing): noted. will attach raw webhook payloads to the ticket for root-cause.

billing-bot: deploy succeeded: fix/rounding-clamp -> staging (sha: c3d2b1)

anika (revops): drafting customer messaging template.

marta (finance): follow-ups: backfill 72h, clean journals in NetSuite, consider disabling experiment if further issues. Thanks team.
